title: The first Island paid once; the others paid twice
era: 1998 Pro Tour Rome Extended combo illustrated under current Oracle wording
matchup: High Tide combo against Academy blue combo
story: I began my main phase with four Island s untapped and High Tide in hand. The first Island paid the single blue to cast Tide; it received no bonus because the spell had not resolved. After it resolved, I tapped two more Islands, each producing two blue, and spent all four to cast Turnabout targeting myself and choosing lands. All my Islands untapped. I then tapped all four for eight blue mana, enough to start working toward Stroke of Genius . My opponent could receive the same Island bonus on their own taps that turn. Tide was symmetrical, not a private enchantment.
review: Four Islands. First taps for U to cast High Tide pre-resolution and no bonus. Second+third after resolution each produce UU -> total four blue for Turnabout {2}{U}{U}. Turnabout targets self and untaps lands including first three, fourth previously untapped. Four Islands afterwards produce 8 blue. Both players' Islands affected.
